about.pitch: Frontend developer building interfaces with React and TypeScript - clean, structured and pleasant to use.
about.firstParagraph: I care about the engineering side of frontend: FSD architecture, scalable SCSS systems, thoughtful component design.

about.thirdParagraph: I am also interested in the creative potential of web development - PixiJS, Framer Motion, Anime.js. Engineering and visual craft is where I want to grow.
